# PLLM

Release: 0.1.0
Build: sha256:1e873bcc571b7b7717ee66b62aff1ec3e361ead12088e6b707b77e88ee008328

Private LLM inference documentation. Public weights; provider follows the protocol.

- [Get started](https://pllm.run/learn/start/) ([Markdown](https://pllm.run/learn/start.md)): Install PLLM, inspect a private inference plan, and run the local development benchmark.
- [Installation](https://pllm.run/learn/start/installation/) ([Markdown](https://pllm.run/learn/start/installation.md)): Install the Python package and verify the CLI without loading a model or contacting a service.
- [Inspect a private inference plan](https://pllm.run/learn/start/first-private-request/) ([Markdown](https://pllm.run/learn/start/first-private-request.md)): Define a reproducible experiment, lower a semantic model plan, and check its execution coverage.
- [Configuration](https://pllm.run/sdk/configuration/) ([Markdown](https://pllm.run/sdk/configuration.md)): Load, inspect, and export a reproducible PLLM experiment configuration.
- [Model plans](https://pllm.run/sdk/plans/) ([Markdown](https://pllm.run/sdk/plans.md)): Lower a model configuration, add components, and inspect compiler coverage.
- [Components](https://pllm.run/sdk/components/) ([Markdown](https://pllm.run/sdk/components.md)): Inspect versioned capabilities and apply compatible components to a model plan.
- [Understand](https://pllm.run/learn/understand/) ([Markdown](https://pllm.run/learn/understand.md)): Understand PLLM's architecture, trust boundaries, privacy assumptions, and evidence model.
- [Architecture](https://pllm.run/learn/understand/architecture/) ([Markdown](https://pllm.run/learn/understand/architecture.md)): Understand PLLM's plans, runtime stages, role ownership, and side effects.
- [Trust boundary](https://pllm.run/learn/understand/trust-boundary/) ([Markdown](https://pllm.run/learn/understand/trust-boundary.md)): Understand what the client, preparation service, inference service, and operators can access.
- [Privacy and assurance semantics](https://pllm.run/learn/understand/privacy-assurance/) ([Markdown](https://pllm.run/learn/understand/privacy-assurance.md)): State a specific privacy claim and interpret the evidence that applies to it.
- [Evidence and claim taxonomy](https://pllm.run/learn/understand/evidence-claims/) ([Markdown](https://pllm.run/learn/understand/evidence-claims.md)): Separate a design contract, an implementation, its evidence, and a publication claim.
- [CLI reference](https://pllm.run/cli/reference/) ([Markdown](https://pllm.run/cli/reference.md)): Exact commands, arguments, and help text from the installed PLLM CLI.
- [Command-line interface](https://pllm.run/cli/) ([Markdown](https://pllm.run/cli.md)): Inspect PLLM configuration, components, and research records from the terminal.
- [Arithmetic and Boolean garbling](https://pllm.run/learn/arithmetic-and-boolean-garbling/) ([Markdown](https://pllm.run/learn/arithmetic-and-boolean-garbling.md)): Compare arithmetic and Boolean garbling without treating one primitive as a complete private runtime.
- [Learn](https://pllm.run/learn/) ([Markdown](https://pllm.run/learn.md)): Understand PLLM's private inference runtime, research harness, trust assumptions, and evidence.
- [Masked linear inference](https://pllm.run/learn/masked-linear-inference/) ([Markdown](https://pllm.run/learn/masked-linear-inference.md)): Follow seeded one-time masks through offline correction and online matrix evaluation.
- [Numeric semantics and model quality](https://pllm.run/learn/numeric-semantics-and-model-quality/) ([Markdown](https://pllm.run/learn/numeric-semantics-and-model-quality.md)): Understand how integer arithmetic affects correctness and model output quality.
- [Parties and offline work](https://pllm.run/learn/parties-and-offline-work/) ([Markdown](https://pllm.run/learn/parties-and-offline-work.md)): Learn what each party does before and during a private inference request.
- [Privacy and threat models](https://pllm.run/learn/privacy-and-threat-models/) ([Markdown](https://pllm.run/learn/privacy-and-threat-models.md)): Learn what PLLM protects, what each party can see, and which trust assumptions still apply.
- [Reading research and evidence](https://pllm.run/learn/reading-research-and-evidence/) ([Markdown](https://pllm.run/learn/reading-research-and-evidence.md)): Learn how PLLM connects papers, clean-room implementations, measurements, and publication claims.
- [Python SDK](https://pllm.run/sdk/) ([Markdown](https://pllm.run/sdk.md)): Plan models, compose research methods, and use supported PLLM runtimes from Python.
- [Run the local development benchmark](https://pllm.run/learn/start/first-local-benchmark/) ([Markdown](https://pllm.run/learn/start/first-local-benchmark.md)): Run the real PLLM roles on one machine and understand what the result does and does not measure.
